source: Sentence-BERT showed this sharply for the BERT models and evaluation setup in its 2019 paper: directly averaging BERT outputs or using the CLS output performed poorly on semantic textual similarity compared with an encoder fine-tuned specifically for sentence embeddings. The point is not the old benchmark number. The point is the objective mismatch. [9]
zh: Sentence-BERT 在其 2019 年论文中清楚地展示了 BERT 模型和评估设置：与专门针对句子嵌入进行微调的编码器相比，直接平均 BERT 输出或使用 CLS 输出在语义文本相似性方面表现不佳。重点不是旧的基准数字。关键是客观不匹配。 [9]
